Args: until [ -f /amane/secrets/postgresql.env ]; do sleep 1; done; . /amane/secrets/postgresql.env; exec /bin/sh /launch.sh init
Name: /amane-postgresql

Env:
SPILO_CONFIGURATION=bootstrap:
  dcs:
    ttl: 20
    loop_wait: 2
    retry_timeout: 5
    synchronous_mode: true
    synchronous_mode_strict: false
    postgresql:
      parameters:
        synchronous_commit: "on"
        max_wal_senders: 5
        max_slot_wal_keep_size: 1024MB
Cmd: until [ -f /amane/secrets/postgresql.env ]; do sleep 1; done; . /amane/secrets/postgresql.env; exec /bin/sh /launch.sh init

Args: until [ -f /amane/haproxy/haproxy.cfg ]; do sleep 1; done; exec haproxy -W -db -S /amane/haproxy/master.sock,mode,666 -f /amane/haproxy/haproxy.cfg
Name: /amane-haproxy

Cmd: until [ -f /amane/haproxy/haproxy.cfg ]; do sleep 1; done; exec haproxy -W -db -S /amane/haproxy/master.sock,mode,666 -f /amane/haproxy/haproxy.cfg

Args: until [ -f /amane/secrets/postgresql.env ]; do sleep 1; done; . /amane/secrets/postgresql.env; export PG_URL="postgres://amane:${AMANE_PG_PASSWORD}@amane-haproxy:5000/amane"; exec /entrypoint.sh run --mode "${NODE_MODE:-passive}"
Name: /ss-node

Entrypoint: until [ -f /amane/secrets/postgresql.env ]; do sleep 1; done; . /amane/secrets/postgresql.env; export PG_URL="postgres://amane:${AMANE_PG_PASSWORD}@amane-haproxy:5000/amane"; exec /entrypoint.sh run --mode "${NODE_MODE:-passive}"
